verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents collecting feedback through an embeddable widget and routing submissions into intentions and tasks. Nothing in the evidence shows it notifying the submitting customers when the status of their request changes. The CLI with --json output and cron support is only a developer building block someone could use to build such notifications, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can automatically notify customers when the status of their requested feature changes
